requirements.title: Core
requirements.section: Prerequisites (Sociology Major and Sociology Research Methods Concentration)
requirements.notes:
For SOCIOL 1:
- Students will earn zero units towards the major if taken after SOCIOL 3/3AC.
For SOCIOL 5:
- You must earn a C- or better for the Sociology BA
- You must earn a B+ or better for the Sociology Research Methods Concentration

requirements.title: Statistics & Logic
requirements.section: Prerequisites (Sociology Major and Sociology Research Methods Concentration)
requirements.notes:
Courses used to fulfill this requirement may be taken pass/no pass.
Also satisfied by:
- AP: Statistics, score 4+

requirements.title: Theory
requirements.notes: Students must complete each course with a C- or better. SOCIOL 101 must be completed before 102.

requirements.title: Capstone Experience
requirements.notes: The department recommends that this course be completed during your senior year.

requirements.title: Survey
requirements.notes: Sociology majors are required to take two courses in two different substantive areas from the following list of sociology "Survey" courses. The two survey courses must be taken from two different substantive areas, distinguished by distinct second digits — e.g., SOCIOL 110 and SOCIOL 180E, but not SOCIOL 180C and SOCIOL 180E.

requirements.title: Electives
requirements.notes: Each course must be at least 3 units.
